title: Bills eager to see what 350-pound former rugby player Travis Clayton can do on defense

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bills eager to see what 350-pound former rugby player Travis Clayton can do on defense
sources.description: Travis Clayton had never played a single game of football when the Bills chose him in the seventh round of the 2024 NFL draft, but the giant Englishman had gone through the NFL's International Player Pathway Program, and the Bills figured that at 6-foot-7 and 350 pounds, and with experience playing rugby, he might develop into an offensive lineman.
